design_thesis: Lumen is not safe currency; it is bait. Saving for upgrades increases the risk of being found.

spend_vs_save_loop.dramatic_question: Do I spend light to survive this moment, or carry it long enough to evolve?

collection_rules: Lumen pickup always grants value before pressure band is recalculated.
Crossing a pressure band plays a subtle warning cue.
Lumen pressure penalty is disabled during noninteractive cutscene and upgrade selection.
Lumen pressure penalty is reduced by 50 percent during first 20 seconds of Sector 01.
validation_plan: Collecting to 40 Lumen increases pressure rate in metrics.
Using Pulse drops Lumen band and reduces pressure.
Upgrade savings creates measurable pressure risk.
Player can clear Sector 01 without understanding advanced economy.
